newsitem.title: USA: Best liquidation proceeds maybe not enough.
newsitem.headline: Best liquidation proceeds maybe not enough.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc said Friday it anticipated that net proceeds from its liquidation would not be sufficient to fully satisfy creditor claims.

The company, which filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code on September 24, also said it projected holders of the Best Products common stock would receive no recovery from the liquidation.

Best said it sold substantially all of its store-related assets to an investment group in November 1996 and it was holding going-out-of business sales at all 180 Best and Best Jewelry stores in 23 states.
